name: Hailo-10H M.2 Key M ET Module Data Sheet Rev. 1.0
notes: Datasheet gives 4 GB or 8 GB LPDDR4 but no bandwidth; 8 GB variant recorded. 17 GB/s is the max theoretical figure from Hailo's own community/engineering answer: LPDDR4 up to 4266 MT/s on a 32-bit bus (2 channels in lock-step), derived rather than a datasheet number.
